summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of three series of senior unsecured callable bonds on 11 September 2026: HKD-denominated tranches totaling CNY 21.6bn (2.769%, due September 2030), CNY 25.7bn (3.227%, due September 2032) and CNY 7.0bn (3.879%, due September 2037), the Thirteenth through Fifteenth Series. Proceeds fund general banking business. The bonds are unregistered under the US Securities Act, sold offshore under Regulation S, and will list on Euronext Dublin's Global Exchange Market. This is an ordinary debt capital markets issuance, not a special situation.
